title: Compose read-only and write permission packs
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `tool_loop` and backend `mock`. A read-only environment pack refuses the write tool; composing it with a write pack via `environment.access_policy` layers allows the same tool. He walks `tool_loop` and verifies permission_denied vs allowed.
implementation: `AccessPolicy` deny-by-default grants; `CompoundPolicy` unions packs via story `environment.access_policy` / Config `get_access_policy`. `AccessControl` enforces tool grants on the product `tool_loop` verb.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenarios `grant_gate_denied.yaml` and `grant_gate_allowed.yaml` drive `tool_loop` with environment grants; expects permission_denied / allowed.
